item.title: ‘Eagle’s Nest,’ Nazi-Era Guesthouse in German Alps, Is Gutted by Fire
item.description: The police said on Saturday that the structure, a tourist attraction for decades, was probably not salvageable. A man was arrested in connection with the blaze.

item.title: Ukraine’s Feeling of Moral Whiplash at the Hands of Trump
item.description: The United States once declared that Ukraine’s fight was the front line in a global battle for freedom. Now the Trump administration is sending money to Moscow.

item.title: Violent Protests Resurface in Albania: What to Know
item.description: Thousands have marched in student demonstrations over education, the cost of living, and a project linked to Jared Kushner, President Trump’s son-in-law.

item.title: The Expat Voters Hoping to Swing Israel’s Election
item.description: The return of thousands of Israeli expats to vote in their country’s tight election has set off debate over their political influence. We traveled to Tel Aviv to find out why.

item.title: Remains Found in Haiti During Hunt for Missing Salvadoran Soldiers
item.description: El Salvador had sent hundreds of troops to find the four men, who disappeared six days ago. The president of El Salvador denied the bodies were those of his soldiers.
